title: power button shows when no such hardware button exists
line: Power Management settings no longer show the power button setting on devices that have no power button.
explanation: The Power Management KCM always set isPowerButtonPresent to true, with a HACK comment saying an API to detect it was missing, so the 'When power button pressed' row showed on every device, including ones like the Nintendo Switch that have no power button. The change asks udev for input devices with ID_INPUT_KEY and checks their key capability bitmap for KEY_POWER, which is the key PowerDevil reacts to, and only shows the row when one is found.

commits.message:
kcm: only show the power button setting when there is a power button

The power button row was always shown because the KCM hardcoded the
button as present, which confused users on devices without one. Check
whether any input device can send the power key and hide it otherwise.

BUG: 488115

media.caption: Master, no input device with a power key: the 'When power button pressed' row is still shown
With the fix, same setup: the row is hidden
With the fix on luna's real input devices (ACPI power button present): the row is still shown

review.text: This replaces the HACK with a real check for KEY_POWER on udev input devices, which matches what PowerDevil reacts to. It falls back to showing the row if udev isn't available, and the media show the row hidden without a power key and still shown on real hardware. The check could live in powerdevilcore next to LidController for symmetry, but it's fine in the KCM. Counting keyboards that advertise KEY_POWER is correct, because PowerDevil acts on those too.
